$comment: Exposure record (task P3.1, C12, T1.9): which released data reached whom, per analysis and source snapshot. A sidecar with its own record_version, written append-only by the custodian at every release and relay; each new version names the canonical SHA-256 of the version before it (previous_sha256) and keeps its entries unchanged, so a new session never clears exposure. contracts/lineage.py checks ordering and appends and derives the envelope data_exposure from it: an entry whose 'seen' holds an exposing kind (signal-region, unblinded-result, sealed-value) makes the analysis exposed from that entry on.

source.$comment: the source snapshot, as in a release manifest's source

previous_sha256.$comment: canonical SHA-256 of the previous version of this record; null only for the first version

via.$comment: the session the release was opened in, or the relay that passed it on

actor.$comment: the person or agent the data reached
